No capacity attachments. Fires Improved Smart Ammunition as if Smart Rebuilt. Its Tech scope sees outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick cover. Aimed Shots deal +1d6 (7d6). Charged, it halves SP but can't shoot through cover. A charged hit with Improved Smart rounds earns a free second attack (no ammo, can be Aimed) at a different target within 10m. If it made a charged attack last Round, it charges without a Move Action. Mounted on a vehicle or similar power source, it counts as silenced. Only a Tech at Maker 7+ can modify or fabricate it.

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • TECH
Range table: Anti-materiel Rifle
Damage: 6d6
Built-in: Smartgun Link, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniper Long Barrel, Sniping Scope, Tech Rebuild
